full_prompt_en: The square image is a bold cartoon group portrait of five men in total, arranged around a stern central man against an orange-brown graphic background. The central man occupies most of the lower middle, with tall black hair, heavy brows and a square jaw. His narrowed eyes look directly forward, and his mouth is pressed into a firm line. He wears a dark teal jacket over a muted red shirt, with broad shoulders cut off by the lower edge. Four other male heads crowd around him at different heights. At the upper left, an older bald man with round spectacles and a grey beard leans inward, with the lower part of his body obscured by the other figures. Behind the central figure near the top, a taller long-faced man with swept grey-green hair looks sideways, his prominent nose and pointed chin exaggerated. At the lower left, a broad bald man with a heavy jaw and narrowed eyes pushes into the frame, cropped at the shoulder. At the right, a man wears a tall, wide-brimmed teal top hat with a pair of brass-rimmed goggles fixed around its band. A curled dark moustache spreads above his long grey beard, and a small lit candle stands beside him at the right edge. Their faces are drawn with thick dark outlines, simplified planes and strongly varied expressions, from the central man’s scowl to the peripheral figures’ wary or stern looks. A glowing bulb-like lamp rises high at the upper right, radiating a warm yellow halo. Behind the heads, thin linework suggests blocky architectural façades and door or window shapes, but no specific room is defined. The background shifts from dark ochre at left to brighter orange near the lamp, with small golden lines and scratches. Light is graphic and warm, catching the faces from the front while leaving the edges and lower clothing in deep teal and charcoal. No readable text appears. The surrounding heads overlap the central shoulders and one another, forming a compact cluster without a visible full-body view. Their hair, facial hair and headwear vary, giving each silhouette a distinct outline. The lamp’s circular halo sits above the rightmost hat and breaks the otherwise dark upper field. Fine orange linework continues behind the group as incomplete rectangles and vertical marks. The strong central scowl anchors the different expressions and prevents the crowded arrangement from losing its focal point. The overall composition forms a tight pyramid around the central figure, with the surrounding heads overlapping one another and the bright lamp balancing the crowded portrait at the upper right.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形的鲜明卡通群像，共五名男子构成群簇，以严肃的中央男子为焦点，背景为橙棕色图形底面。中央男子占据下方中部大部分，留着高耸黑发、浓眉和方下颌。眯起的眼睛直视前方，嘴唇紧抿成一道直线。他穿深青绿色外套，内搭低饱和红色衬衫，宽肩被画面下缘裁切。另有四张男性面孔以不同高度挤在他周围。左上方，一位戴圆眼镜、蓄灰胡须的年长秃头男子向内倾身，下方身体被其他人物遮住。中央人物后方靠上，一位脸形较长、灰绿色头发向后掠起的高个男子斜眼看向一侧，突出的鼻子和尖下巴经过夸张处理。左下方，一名宽脸秃头男子以沉重下颌和眯起双眼挤入画面，肩部被裁切。右侧男子戴青绿色高顶宽檐礼帽，帽带上固定着一副黄铜色镜框的护目镜。弯卷深色八字胡在长灰胡须上方展开，右边缘紧邻他的位置立着一支点燃的小蜡烛。五张脸都以粗黑线条、简化色面和差异明显的神态绘出，从中央人物的怒容到外围人物警惕或严肃的目光各不相同。右上方高处有一盏灯泡状发光灯，周围散出暖黄色光晕。头部后方的细线暗示块状建筑立面和门窗形状，但没有明确的室内场景。背景从左侧深赭色转向灯旁较亮橙色，间杂金色细线和擦痕。光线图形化而温暖，从正面照亮面孔，边缘与下方衣服则沉入深青和炭灰。画面中没有可读文字。周围的头部与中央人物肩膀及彼此交叠，形成紧密群簇，没有出现完整全身。各人的发型、胡须和帽饰不同，因此剪影轮廓各自分明。灯具的圆形光晕位于最右帽子上方，打破上部原本较暗的区域。细橙线在群像后方继续勾出不完整矩形与竖向痕迹。中央人物紧锁的神情稳住其余表情差异，使拥挤布局仍保有焦点。整体构图围绕中央人物形成紧密金字塔式群簇，周围面孔彼此叠压，右上方明灯则平衡拥挤群像。
style_prompt_en: The cartoon illustration uses bold contour lines, simplified shapes and expressive exaggeration. Teal, charcoal, muted red, ochre and orange create a warm-cool balance, with a concentrated yellow glow as a focal accent. Broad colour planes define structure, while small line marks suggest surface and background detail. Forms overlap tightly but remain readable through strong silhouettes and varied scale. Lighting is graphic rather than naturalistic, with warm highlights against deep shadow. The overall treatment is energetic and boldly stylized, balancing a central visual anchor with a crowded, asymmetrical arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 卡通插画采用粗重轮廓线、简化形体和富有表现力的夸张。青绿、炭黑、低饱和红、赭色与橙色形成冷暖平衡，集中的黄色光晕成为强调点。宽阔色面界定结构，细小线痕则提示表面和背景细节。形体紧密叠压，但凭借清晰剪影与大小变化仍易于辨读。光线偏图形化而非写实，暖色高光与深影并置。整体处理活泼且具大胆风格化，在中央视觉锚点和拥挤、不对称的布局之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Five exaggerated cartoon men with a stern black-haired man in front
theme_zh: 以严肃黑发男子为前景焦点的五人夸张卡通群像
name: Doug TenNapel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
